why: Fourth tests round for slice 1, after CI run 43793021396 found next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/effect-checks.test.ts red as a whole suite: SchemaError: Missing key at compilerOptions.plugins[0].overrides[3].options.diagnosticSeverity. The law's own schema required diagnosticSeverity in every checker override, and the new .agents/** override carries only allowedDuplicatedPackages. @effect/tsgo 0.63.0's schema.json requires no field in an override (effectLanguageServicePluginOverrideDefinition and effectLanguageServicePluginOverrideOptionsDefinition have no required list), so the law's schema was wrong to require it. diagnosticSeverity is now optional in the law's schema, and the law reads each override's severities when they are present. This does not loosen the law: what it asserts is unchanged, each listed check set exactly once, at error, with its next/ include and exclude, and an override with no severities cannot set or lower a check. The override was not padded. Merged origin/main first. The law was seen red locally before the fix with the same SchemaError, and green after.
